text:
anna_chen: Quick update — ran SmoothQuant + activation-aware quant on the 13B model with 128k context. Short summary: int8-AWQ w/ prefetch enabled shows good throughput but we see a drift in token-level logits around 8k-12k tokens, higher perplexity on longholdout set.

rajiv: Can you paste the exact config and the bench command?

anna_chen: Sure — run used prefetch=true, kv_flip_eviction=true, act_scale=1.12, smooth_lambda=0.04. Bench command: `./bench --model r13b --quant awq-int8 --context 131072 --prefetch on --seed 42 --holdout longspan`

sophie_k: Noted. Do you have a diff vs fp16 baseline for perplexity / exact-match at various token windows?

anna_chen: Quick numbers from the regression harness (holdout longspan subset):
```
window 0-4k: ppl +0.8% vs fp16
window 4k-8k: ppl +1.3%
window 8k-12k: ppl +4.9%  <-- big jump
window 12k-32k: ppl +2.1%
overall: ppl +2.3%
```
Exact-match on QA slices dips by ~1.6% in 8k-12k window.

rajiv: That 8k-12k spike smells like KV-cache eviction/ordering. Did you change chunking or kv flip params?

anna_chen: We flipped kv_eviction policy to 'flip-on-prefetch' to keep memory stable across runs (experiment to reduce tail latency). Kernel traces show occasional stale KV lookups when the prefix cache boundary crosses prefetch windows.

mike_ops: deploy-bot created a canary bench job: bench/128k-sq-actprefetch/2476510000. Logs uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/128k/2476510000/logs.tar.gz

rajiv: Can you attach a short log snippet around the failure? Even a few lines showing KV ops would help.

anna_chen: Pasted snippet from runtime trace (trimmed):
```
[12:02:01] KV_PREFETCH start range 8192-16384
[12:02:01] KV_INSERT seq 8192 .. 16384 ok
[12:02:01] KV_EVICT candidate seq 4096 .. 8191
[12:02:02] KV_LOOKUP miss seq 8120 -> fallback compute
[12:02:02] GENERATED tokens 8120..8135 latency spike
```
Observation: a lookup miss for seq 8120 while we had a prefetch for 8192-16384; off-by-one window interaction.

sophie_k: Hmm. Could be prefetch window granularity vs token boundary in the batching runtime. Also activation scaling (act_scale 1.12) might amplify errors when KV misses cause recompute.

rajiv: Two quick repro ideas: 1) run without kv_flip_eviction (keep default LRU) and compare 8k-12k window; 2) reduce prefetch granularity to 4k pages and rerun.

anna_chen: On it. I'll run both. Prefetch->4k granularity first, and no-kv-flip afterwards. ETA ~ 2h.

mike_ops: FYI the canary job was scheduled on a 4xA100 node pool; cost estimate ~ $18/hr. Tag with `sq-actprefetch-kvflip` for billing.

deploy-bot: bench job bench/128k-sq-actprefetch/2476513600 queued on pool-a100-4x.

sophie_k: Also flag to eval team: add a token-resolved QA probe around 8k-13k to capture semantics drop. We need both PPL and downstream metric traces.

anna_chen: Will add. If the no-kv-flip run fixes it, we should consider reverting kv_flip on the 128k path until we can make prefetch atomic.

rajiv: Agreed. Thanks — please post the two run diffs here when ready. :thumbsup:
